My structured understanding — confirm or refine it.

This process handles the review and approval of contractor invoices that are below a specified monetary threshold. Typically, contractors submit their invoices to a designated reviewer or manager who verifies the invoice details before granting approval. The process likely involves checking the invoice against contract terms and budget limits to ensure accuracy and compliance.
To efficiently approve contractor invoices under the specified threshold to ensure timely payment and maintain budget control.
Managers or supervisors responsible for overseeing contractor work and invoice approvals, as well as the finance or accounts payable team who process payments.

Once approved, the invoice is forwarded to the finance team for payment processing, enabling contractors to receive timely compensation and ensuring accurate financial records. The user receives confirmation of approval and can proceed with payment scheduling.
